Rae (sales): Helix asked for the simplest Dedicated POC: single static egress IP + scoped API key for 10 days. Can we do that?
Dev (solutions): Yes. We can reserve one managed EIP for the POC and issue a generate-only token with a 10d expiry. Need Helix to allowlist a /32.
Sam - Helix IT: Single /32 works. We need the IP tonight and confirmation rotation won't happen mid-POC.
Nina (neteng): We'll mark the EIP as non-rotating for the 10d window. If emergent maintenance required we'll give 48h notice.
Omar (security): Security requirements: scoped token, audit logs enabled, TLS 1.2+, and we'll send SOC2 excerpt on request. No mTLS required for the POC.
Dev (solutions): Example allowlist rule to send them:
```
allow from 198.51.100.77/32 to dedicated.us-west-2.redwood.com port 443
```
Dev (solutions): Example curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer POC_HELIX_01" \\
  -d '{"input":"hi"}' \\
  https://dedicated.us-west-2.redwood.com/v1/generate
```
OpsBot: Provisioning dedicated-endpoint/poc-1833333333 started at 1833333350.
Nina (neteng): EIP assigned: 198.51.100.77 (us-west-2). Reserved 2024-06-10 to 2024-06-20.
Sam - Helix IT: Added 198.51.100.77/32 to firewall. Testing now.
Dev (solutions): Token created and DM'ed to Sam. Scopes: ["generate"], expiry 10d. Audit logs enabled.
Sam - Helix IT: Verified connectivity and token auth. Latency looks fine. Thanks!
Rae (sales): Action items: finance confirm usage billing waiver (Rae), security upload SOC2 excerpt if asked (Omar), neteng log rotation window (Nina).
Nina (neteng): Logged rotation policy = 48h notice.
Rae (sales): Great — I'll send POC kickoff and calendar invite. :thumbsup:
